about_the_game:
Step into the immersive world of GraeHart in this story-driven demo, offering a glimpse into the realm’s early chapters and rich exploration.

Begin your journey in the bustling town of Terith, then travel to Penrith, a settlement steeped in history and mystery. Explore the entire Mid-lands region, where danger, secrets, and adventure await beyond every ridge and forest trail.

This demo includes the first two chapters of the game, giving you a taste of GraeHart’s branching narrative and character-driven story. Interact with a diverse cast, uncover hidden quests, and make choices that subtly shape your path.

Face off against enemies lurking in the wild, master turn-based combat, gather loot, and upgrade your abilities as you uncover the early threats facing the realm.

Whether you're unraveling local lore, exploring the highlands, or testing your strength in battle, this demo introduces the core mechanics, tone, and world of GraeHart.

Are you ready to take your first steps into Terith, Penrith, and beyond?

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains drug use, alcohol usage

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7/8/8.1/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or i7 (8th Gen or newer) / AMD Ryzen 5 or 7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560 and above
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Explore Terith, Penrith, and the Mid-lands in this story-driven demo. Play through the first two chapters, uncover secrets, battle enemies, and shape your path in a world where every choice matters. Your journey begins now.
